evidence.quote: My remarks today focus on "stablecoins," the highest-profile example of a new and fast-growing payments technology.
However, I disagree with the notion that stablecoin issuance can or should only be conducted by banks, simply because of the nature of the liability.
In the interest of competition and of the consumers it benefits, we should get to work.
